findings.subject: dedicated environment
findings.promised_value: Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region
findings.contract_value: Amazon Web Services in the Sydney region
findings.reason: The RFP response promised hosting on Microsoft Azure in Australia East, but the Statement of Work instead commits to Amazon Web Services in Sydney — a direct conflict on both cloud provider and region that will confuse delivery and customer expectations.
